sources.entry: SideNotes - Quick notes on the screen side with Markdown support.

summary.name: SideNotes
summary.one_liner: A macOS note-taking app that shows and hides on the side of the screen so you can jot notes without switching apps.
use_cases: quick note capture during lectures or meetings
keeping a running task list at the screen edge
storing study concepts and exam reminders
grabbing screenshots or text into a notes inbox
organising notes into folders by project or subject
summary.what_it_does: SideNotes is a note-taking app that appears on top of other windows and can be shown or hidden with a keyboard shortcut, an Open Bar click, or by moving the mouse to the screen edge. It supports Markdown formatting with the markup hidden, plus tasks, images, file shortcuts, and #rrggbb colour codes. Notes can be grouped into folders, pinned, folded, and colour-coded. The page says it syncs via iCloud, includes automatic backups, and offers integrations with Apple Shortcuts, an AppleScript API, a URL-based API, and apps such as Alfred, Hookmark, PopClip, Dropzone, and Raycast.
notable: Sits on top of other apps, including full screen and Stage Manager, with a Hot Side edge-hover mode
Markdown formatting with markup hidden from view
Integrations with Apple Shortcuts, AppleScript, a URL API, Alfred, Raycast, and PopClip
Companion SideNotes Mobile for iPhone and iPad, sold separately
caveats: One-time payment covers SideNotes 1.x only; SideNotes 2 is a paid upgrade with a discount for existing users
Requires macOS 13 or newer; SideNotes Mobile requires iOS/iPadOS 17 or newer
SideNotes and SideNotes Mobile are sold separately
